summary: rYojbaba Co., Ltd., a Japanese foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing its board's October 14, 2026 resolution to allot 346,500 stock acquisition rights (paid stock options) to VITA HEALTH PTE. LTD. of Singapore, with allotment scheduled October 30, 2026. The subscription price is $0.0080 per right ($2,772 aggregate, equal to third-party fair value); each right buys one share at $3.50, worth $1,212,750 if fully exercised. Exercise is conditioned on the holder delivering JPY 100 million cumulative Contribution Profit by December 31, 2028. This is an ordinary compensatory/strategic option grant, not a special situation.
